post.title: [Hiring] Wedding highlight editor - DM only
post.body: Need a 5-minute highlight film edited from about 3 hours of wedding footage (two cameras, drone shots). Music licensed already. Budget $250. DM only - public comments will be ignored and I don't answer replies on this thread.

analysis.summary: Edit a 5-minute wedding highlight film from about 3 hours of two-camera and drone footage; $250.

expect: follows DM only: the comment is empty or a one-line note
the DM mentions the highlight film
is honest that it has no wedding work in the evidence
